reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Great air cooler.
reviews.comment: Great so far. Keeps a 14600k very cool under load. Easy installation and sits above my RAM (T-Create Expert) just fine. The display is a nice touch and the lights look nice and understated in my mostly otherwise dark case. The only downside is the massive size. You may want to install the radiator after the rest of your build is assembled. Working around this bulk isn't easy. Quiet until you push things, it's normally silent. Overall, a fantastic value.
reviews.author: CT

reviews.title: CPU is icy cold ❄️
reviews.comment: Keeps my i7 12700kf ice cold (50c under load) The screen works well too. I recommend this if you want good temps without going the Aio route.
reviews.author: Colin

reviews.title: Great buying experience BUT
reviews.comment: You will want to check the dimensions. I’m using the dual channel slots of RGB ram which is taller. The intake fan covers the 3rd and 4th slot. This means you have raise the fan quite a bit. This could cause some cases not to close on the side panel. I ended up flipping the intake fan and using it on the exhaust fan. The fan is now pulling warm out vs pushing cool air in. The CPU got very hot (95C) during certain gaming processes even with all 15 fans running (counting the GPU). I’m sure it will work on better on a 65W TDP processor vs the 105W and maybe without RGB ram. The build quality is great so I’m going to switch to a liquid cooler from the same brand.
reviews.author: Ashley
